title: Infini — Retained Developer Admin Access Drain Analysis
loss_raw: ~$49,500,000 (USDC drained from Infini's yield vault contracts)
root_cause: A developer who contributed to the Infini protocol secretly retained admin-level private key access to the protocol's contracts after completing their engagement. On February 24, 2025, this developer used the retained admin access to drain ~$49.5M in USDC from Infini's vault contracts.
vulnerable_contract: Infini InfiniCard yield vault (admin privilege access control)
steps: → Flash loan used to amplify the withdrawal in a single transaction
[Laundering] Convert USDC → DAI (to avoid Circle's USDC blacklisting authority)
